# Agent Python Tools

- repo: NousResearch/hermes-agent
- repo_uri: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent

## File: NousResearch_hermes-agent/optional-skills/blockchain/solana/scripts/solana_client.py

Prompts

```
['run the solana_client stats command to get network slot, epoch, TPS, supply, and SOL price', 'run the solana_client wallet command to query a Solana address balance and SPL token holdings with USD values', 'run the solana_client tx command to fetch transaction details by signature including balance changes', 'run the solana_client token command to retrieve SPL token metadata, supply, price, and top holders', 'run the solana_client activity command to list recent transaction signatures for a Solana address', 'run the solana_client nft command to list NFTs owned by a Solana wallet address', 'run the solana_client whales command to scan the latest block for large SOL transfers', 'run the solana_client price command to look up token price by mint address or known symbol']
```

Usage

```
{'run_stats': 'run the solana_client stats command to get network slot, epoch, TPS, supply, and SOL price', 'run_wallet_balance': 'run the solana_client wallet command to query a Solana address balance and SPL token holdings with USD values', 'run_tx_details': 'run the solana_client tx command to fetch transaction details by signature including balance changes', 'run_token_info': 'run the solana_client token command to retrieve SPL token metadata, supply, price, and top holders', 'run_activity': 'run the solana_client activity command to list recent transaction signatures for a Solana address', 'run_nft_portfolio': 'run the solana_client nft command to list NFTs owned by a Solana wallet address', 'run_whale_scan': 'run the solana_client whales command to scan the latest block for large SOL transfers', 'run_price_lookup': 'run the solana_client price command to look up token price by mint address or known symbol'}
```
